findings.observation: Clamping ridge_half to zero makes the two consecutive ridge vertices equal in each long-side polygon. The edge builder retains the resulting zero-length edge and may merge the matching edge of the opposite face as a shared ridge; the edge-treatment branch floors its geometric plan length to 0.05 m when constructing its intermediate solid. No claim is made that this intermediate solid survives later treatment.

BuildingProgram fields are public, but the inspected source does not establish a supported footprint reaching the condition past all generation gates. audit/roofs flags surviving edges <=0.02 m; generate_document invokes audit whereas generate calls generate_unchecked. Do not assert accepted output, public impact, absence of later cleanup, or runtime evidence.

findings.status: source-level rule observation; defect impact and canonical owner unresolved
findings.observation: Roof kernels repeat inline thresholds while applying the same 0.0001 value both to x/z coordinate comparisons and to oriented 2-D cross-product side comparisons. These quantities have different dimensional meaning; the fixed side threshold also corresponds to a distance margin that depends on edge length. Other inline squared-distance and cross-product tolerances have no named calculation owner in these assigned bodies.
findings.qualification: The project rules require owned, unit-aware and conditioned tolerances; review actual calculation error budgets and all recipients before selecting a policy. There is no asserted witnessed player-visible failure, no claim that thresholds must share one constant, and no automatic alias with broader geometry findings.
findings.future_direction: Have the owning numerical kernels state separate distance, squared-distance and oriented-area tolerances with the intended scale/error budget and preserve deliberate clipping behavior. Assess historical and other geometry work for semantic identity before ledger deduplication.

lenses.bounded_assessment: Cuboid serde tuple name Vec3 is an external-format identity, not an internal status discriminator; no roof business string dispatch observed in the assigned bodies. Derive/wire equivalence is open.

Roof geometry embeds mixed-dimension tolerances and resolution includes roof thickness, edge-size and structure thresholds. Rule-owned units and error budgets need review; see CANDIDATE-ROOF-LOCAL-TOLERANCE-DIMENSION-POLICY. Pure axes and indexing alone are not findings.

CuboidDimensions owns checked nonnegative extents over SignedLength; do not merge with positive length or signed offsets. Canonical architectural point, coupled roof plane and topology ownership remains connected to 774 F001/RAW-SOURCE-002.

Position<Architectural> is already admitted then discarded before retained raw polygon. CuboidDimensions is already used when cuts mutate a solid size; semantic numerical kernels require genuine native boundary, not indiscriminate wrappers.

Cuboid intentionally includes zero/point/line shapes; roof face must separately own stronger topology and nonvertical-plane requirements if consumers require them. Do not make zero universally invalid.

Plane normal derivation and height division are not guarded for degenerate/vertical data by bounds alone; finite polygon positions do not by themselves prove finite sums, normals or area. Producer reachability and later audits remain open.

RoofFace stores polygon, plane, pitch, thickness and support identifiers independently. Their mutual validity and collapsed half-hip ridge topology cannot be guaranteed by independent leaf checks alone; exact input and recipient policy pending.

Cuboid constructor checks finiteness and nonnegative axes; serde re-enters it. Roof bounds check cardinality and finite positions but do not establish plane/topology guarantees; public RoofPiece/RoofFace construction and decoding require separate boundary tracing.

RoofKind/RidgeAxis and typed RoofEdgeKind express actual closed distinctions. shed_high_side is coupled to kind, but do not declare a defect from Option alone: assess actual producer and owning plan validators.

RoofFace retains polygon and a computed plane; later consumers use both. A divergence contract is a relationship question, not proof that one field is a needless duplicate or that deliberate cached authority is invalid.

No repairs were made. Historical roof bytes match 95e; cuboid full diff changes only signature line wrapping. Preserve zero extents, precise evaluation order, typed errors, scaled plane and format identity in any future proposal.
